payload.description_html: Kunpengornis is a euornithean bird that lived during the Early Cretaceous period in what is now China. It grew to about 40 cm in length, and had teeth like many birds in the Mesozoic. Thanks to preserved fish bones in the abdominal cavity of the type specimen, Kunpengornis is known to have had a piscivorous diet.
